newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Maple Oil to complete producing well.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Maple Oil to complete producing well.

text.p: Maple Oil NL said on Monday its Inland No 5 development well in the Cooper-Ermomanga Basin in south-west Queensland will be completed as a producing oil well.

Maple said an analysis of wireline logs in the lower Hutton sandstone indicated a 15 metre oil column with good reservoir potential. A drill stem test of good oil shows in the higher McKinlay sandstone would be also be conducted, it said.
Maple holds a 40 percent interest in the Inland Oilfield and the surrounding Petroleum Lease, PL-98.
The remaining 60 percent is held by a private Brisbane-based company, IOR Exploration Pty Ltd, a Maple Oil spokeswoman said.
